decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the core agency-focused, round-the-clock support promise and is cheap to carry with existing staff, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The version manager is built into the firm's management tools alongside the security center and recovery manager and lowers recurring work for customers, so it supports the core aspiration and needs little extra upkeep.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer and its post-GDPR novelty may fade, which makes it the most likely candidate for reallocation, but its upkeep is low and the firm's slack lets it be carried as a compliance service for agencies.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that embodies the firm's strategic direction, so management will defend and develop it rather than drop it.
